# Intuit Expands Intelligence Platform to Power the Next Era of Accounting Firm and Business Growth


October 27, 2026 8:30am EDT[Download as PDF](https://investors.intuit.com/_assets/_c75a201fc18597127cff247bc9ecce37/intuit/news/2026-10-27_Intuit_Expands_Intelligence_Platform_to_Power_the__1329.pdf)


*Across QuickBooks, Intuit Enterprise Suite, and Intuit Accountant Suite, Intuit Intelligence brings businesses and accountants together on one unified intelligent platform, pairing AI with human expertise to deliver time-saving automation, deeper insights, and greater confidence*


*New industry-specific editions for Intuit Enterprise Suite empower mid-market businesses across construction, manufacturing, and nonprofits to scale with financial intelligence alongside the accountants who advise them*


LAS VEGAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Intuit Inc.](https://www.intuit.com/) (Nasdaq: INTU), the global financial technology platform that makes[TurboTax](https://turbotax.intuit.com/) ,[Credit Karma](https://www.creditkarma.com/) ,[QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/) ,[Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/) ,[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://www.intuit.com/enterprise/?cid=ppc_G_e_US_.IES_US_GGL_Core_Brand_Search_Desktop_WP._intuit%20enterprise%20suite_txt&agid=168077376392&infinity=ict2~net~gaw~ar~713851370530~kw~intuit%20enterprise%20suite~mt~e~cmp~IES_US_GGL_Core_Brand_Search_Desktop_WP~ag~Brand&gclsrc=aw.ds&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=21711323714&gbraid=0AAAAAD1w8J8bI_Q2HPwtu3vt0HtIkTOc8&gclid=Cj0KCQiAp-zLBhDkARIsABcYc6s1NYCojx2PPTREBXIIov7BhqQHfdb0BonJQdeL8tIYnPFApPYiVigaAlrfEALw_wcB) , and[Intuit Accountant Suite](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/intuit-accountant-suite/) , today announced a wave of new innovation fueled by Intuit Intelligence, Intuit’s unified platform that delivers intelligence and automation that is transforming how businesses and accountants work together.


At[Intuit Connect](https://www.intuit.com/intuitconnect/) , the company’s flagship event for accounting firms and business leaders, Intuit demonstrated how Intuit Intelligence helps accountants and businesses of all sizes thrive in the AI era, enabling them to work together with confidence on a single intelligent platform. Delivering AI at scale, Intuit’s connected financial network brings businesses and the accountants who advise them closer together, with shared context, intelligence, and agentic workflows across the Intuit ecosystem.


Intuit showcased new innovations fueled across the platform, including industry-specific editions in Intuit Enterprise Suite, monthly Agentic Books Close in Intuit Accountant Suite, and smarter invoicing and cash flow management in QuickBooks. Together these innovations save time and money, drive operational efficiency, deliver actionable, trusted intelligence, and take action on the customer’s behalf while remaining compliant and accurate.


“With Intuit Intelligence, we’re harnessing the power of AI so businesses and accountants can continue to lead through the largest technology disruption in our history, one that is fundamentally changing how they compete and grow,” said Sasan Goodarzi, Intuit Chairman and CEO. “Intuit Intelligence brings businesses and accountants together on one financial system of intelligence, combining trusted data, deep expertise, AI, and human intelligence to increasingly do the work and deliver the insights that drive better decisions. Millions of businesses and the accountants they trust can now work from one intelligent platform, with shared financial context, insights, and automation. That connection is incredibly powerful: accountants can deliver more value to their clients, businesses can grow with greater confidence, and both become stronger together.”


The Intuit Intelligence platform is built on decades of trusted, permissioned financial data, deep expertise across financial domains and industries, and an architecture that selects the right intelligence for each task, from AI and machine learning to deterministic code and human expertise. Because it works as one unified platform, that intelligence moves beyond generic answers to deliver more personalized automation, insights, and action for businesses and the accountants who serve them.


**Delivering Trusted Financial Intelligence and Automation with Intuit Intelligence**


Intuit Intelligence brings businesses and accounting firms onto one connected financial platform, helping them understand performance, automate work, and take action with greater confidence. By carrying financial context across Intuit products built for every stage of growth, it delivers more relevant insights and automation for all customers on the Intuit platform.


The power of Intuit Intelligence is its three foundational layers, working seamlessly together:


- **Trusted, proprietary data:** Unmatched financial context at scale, informed by 82 million consumers, 10 million businesses, and 650,000 accountants, built on decades of trusted, permissioned first-party financial data and combined with third-party data from banks, employers, and other sources. This gives businesses a full, real-time view of their finances and informs business intelligence insights, paired with recommended actions that empower them to make informed financial decisions.
- **Deep financial and industry expertise:** The Intuit Intelligence platform is powered by expertise spanning dozens of financial domains, more than 100 workflows, and over 300 industries, embedding it directly into the customer experience so specialized knowledge that once lived inside a single product can now be applied anywhere a business needs it.
- **The right intelligence for the job, every time** : Intuit Intelligence doesn’t rely on a single AI model or approach. It orchestrates more than 60 specialized language models and over 100 AI skill agents across 100-plus workflows and 74 financial domains, selecting the right intelligence for each task. Depending on what the work requires, that can mean a large language model, traditional machine learning, deterministic and compliance-grade code, or a human expert. By matching each job to the approach best suited to it, Intuit Intelligence embeds specialized expertise directly into everyday operations while keeping businesses and accountants in control of important decisions.


The impact is already significant. Millions of customers rely on capabilities, features, and workflows enabled by Intuit Intelligence with AI categorizing more than 400 million transactions monthly. Intuit Intelligence streamlines tasks, from running payroll, paying bills, sending invoices, extending capital, and more. It turns recommendations into completed actions rather than another dashboard to act on manually, reducing repetitive work to accelerate operations and deliver meaningful outcomes. These automations are freeing up time across business operations, with accountants seeing an estimated 30% reduction in manual work, so they can focus on other key advisory tasks.


**Fueling Accounting Firm Growth with Intuit Accountant Suite**


These announcements come at a moment of rapid change for the accounting profession. Technology is moving fast, client expectations are rising, and the way firms operate is transforming in real time. Rather than waiting for the future of the profession to be defined for them, accountants are leaning in, adapting, and reinventing what it means to be an accountant in the AI era. Intuit Intelligence is built for that moment: one unified intelligence platform designed to help firms run stronger practices and deliver more value across every stage of their clients' growth.


For accounting firms, Intuit Accountant Suite puts the full power of the Intuit Intelligence platform in their hands, giving them one place to manage their work, clients, firm, and teams. Manual work is automated and customized for firms to scale, with the accountant's judgment still at the center. Intuit Intelligence gives firms the ability to deepen client relationships and expand into higher-value advisory work with meaningful insights and portfolio intelligence capabilities. The platform is built around how accountants actually work. Rather than asking firms to build their practices around specific technology, Intuit is increasingly making its offerings more open and agnostic, integrating with the tools and systems firms and their clients already use. Since launching, Intuit Accountant Suite has been adopted by more than 250,000 accounting firms, allowing them to spend significantly more time on high-value advisory work aided by AI recommendations. New innovations include:


- Agentic Books Close runs more of the monthly close process automatically, following a firm's own standard operating procedures and tracking actions in an audit log, while accountants supervise, review, approve, and manage exceptions.
- Firm Playbooks and portfolio intelligence capabilities help firms standardize onboarding and workflows across clients and surface portfolio-level insights, anomalies, and benchmarks across their entire book of business.
- ProPartner, a new program launching in early 2027, provides training and certifications, and access to rewards and benefits, including elevated support and product discounts, to help firms of every size grow their advisory services. Soon, firms will also have the opportunity to scale with the ability to connect with businesses on the Intuit platform that need their expertise.


“The power of Intuit Accountant Suite is that it blends Intuit's software, our team’s human expertise, and AI,” said Matthew May, CAS Partner, Sorren. “It allows us to leverage the right resource at the right time, reducing variability in our tactical work and freeing up time for deeper connections with our clients.”


**Fueling Mid-Market Growth with Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Online Advanced**


The Intuit Intelligence platform grows with customers to meet their scaling ambitions. Industry-specific, AI-native capabilities allow mid-market businesses to grow on the Intuit platform or make the switch from legacy ERPs. Because larger businesses can run seamlessly with Intuit Enterprise Suite or QuickBooks Online Advanced, they avoid the cost, lost time, and disruption historically associated with ERP adoption. With the power of Intuit Intelligence and industry depth, these businesses can manage greater complexity and scale with confidence.


New and expanded capabilities and benefits within Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Online Advanced include:


- Deepening industry capabilities with investments in construction, and extending purpose-built industry experiences for nonprofits and manufacturing, customized for how these businesses operate. Manufacturing businesses get real workflows for multi-location inventory and production, from pick-pack-ship to multi-level bill of materials, while nonprofits get fund and grant accounting built into the platform instead of managed through spreadsheets.
- New Revenue Management capabilities will deliver modern, automated contract-to-cash workflows, including deal configuration and pricing, billing, collections, and revenue recognition as a result of Intuit’s recent[acquisition of Sequence](https://investors.intuit.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1327/intuit-to-acquire-ai-native-revenue-management-platform-sequence) .
- An adaptable, enterprise-ready platform, Intuit Enterprise Suite serves as the financial command center for growing businesses. With multi-entity consolidation, multi-currency support, custom controls, and expanded reporting, it gives finance teams a real-time view across the business and replaces the fragmented, manual work of stitching together multiple systems.


“AI and modern ERP are changing what business leaders should expect from their advisors, and Aprio is turning that change into opportunity for our clients,” said Jordan Fladell, Partner, Technology Advisory, Aprio. “We are putting these technologies to work to help small and mid-sized businesses make smarter decisions and move with greater speed. Our work with Intuit strengthens that vision and gives us another way to shape what the next generation of accounting and advisory looks like.”


**Powering Small Businesses and Entrepreneurs with QuickBooks**


For small businesses and entrepreneurs, QuickBooks is designed to meet customers at every stage. From a new business's first invoice to a scaling company's more complex needs, QuickBooks helps owners stay on top of the day-to-day, make better decisions, and keep moving their business forward. And the need is great. The[2026 Intuit QuickBooks Small Business Late Payments Report](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/small-business-data/small-business-late-payments-report-2026/) reveals that nearly 3 in 5 small businesses have invoices overdue by 30 days or more, up from 47% last year. From tackling late payments to simplifying money management and managing teams, new Intuit Intelligence-powered innovations for QuickBooks customers include:


- AI-powered cash flow and invoicing tools that proactively surface aging invoices, benchmark a business against peers, and automatically follow up with customers to help businesses get paid 4 days faster on average.
- Expanded money management, including the Intuit Business Credit Card, integrated bill pay, and capital offered at the moment of need so financing, spending controls, and everyday bookkeeping work together in one place instead of across separate apps.
- Enhanced Sales Tax preparation, with a redesigned liability report, a Pre-File Check that flags discrepancies, and in-app eFiling and payment to state agencies, streamlining compliance workflows and cutting preparation from hours to minutes.
- Human Capital Management, extending Intuit's payroll capabilities, which processes more than $350 billion for 18 million workers nationwide annually, into broader hiring, benefits, and team management tools for growing employers.


**Accountants Are Core to the Power of Intuit Intelligence**


Using Intuit Connect as the stage to unveil its latest innovations, Intuit further emphasized its long-standing commitment to accountants with the launch of a marquee accountant marketing campaign across Las Vegas. The campaign features accountant customers and highlights the impact they have on their clients’ success. Intuit’s AI-native financial technology platform also came to life through an activation at Sphere, capping off Intuit’s takeover of Las Vegas.


This marks the third year Intuit Connect has brought together thousands of accounting professionals and business leaders from firms of every size in Las Vegas. Across three days of programming, Oct. 26-28, attendees build connections with one another, earn continuing professional education credits, hear from influential speakers, and see the latest Intuit platform innovations across Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks, and Intuit Accountant Suite.


**Availability**


To learn more about the latest innovations, visit our[QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/product-update/whats-new-quickbooks-fall-2026/) ,[Firm of the Future](https://www.firmofthefuture.com/product-update/intuit-accountant-suite-fall-2026-updates/) , and[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/blog/product-update/fall-2026-intuit-enterprise-suite-release-notes/) blogs.


Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks, and Intuit Accountant Suite capabilities described above are rolling out to U.S.-based businesses and accounting firms starting today, with additional capabilities and international availability to follow. Firm Playbooks and portfolio intelligence in Intuit Accountant Suite are currently in beta. Agentic Books Close, an add-on to Intuit Accountant Suite, is coming soon. The Intuit Enterprise Suite construction and manufacturing capabilities are currently in beta. Intuit Enterprise Suite multi-currency support and the nonprofit and revenue management capabilities are coming soon.


**About Intuit**


[Intuit](http://intuit.com/) is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the consumers, businesses and accountants we serve, with products including[TurboTax](https://turbotax.intuit.com/) ,[Credit Karma](https://www.creditkarma.com/) ,[QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/) ,[Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/) ,[Intuit Enterprise Suite](https://erp.intuit.com/) and[Intuit Accountant Suite](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/accountants/intuit-accountant-suite) . Intuit's financial intelligence brings together decades of trusted data, deep financial expertise, AI, and human experts to help customers at every stage of their financial journey. This puts more money in their pockets, saves time by reducing manual work, and ensures they have complete confidence in every financial decision. For more information, visit[Intuit.com](http://intuit.com/) .
